newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 16 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 16 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 16 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Iowa City, Iowa, $10.6 million sewer revenue bonds.
--Easton, Mass., $3.205 million muni purpose loan GOs.
--Prince George's County, Md., $39.3 million public improvement GOs and $5.488 million unlimited tax bonds.
--Candor CSD, N.Y., $8.207 million school district bonds.
--Harris Cty MUD #109, Texas, $2.910 million waterworks and sewer system revs.
--Rosenberg, Texas, $2.075 million water and sewer revs and $3.975 million certificates of obligation.
--Saginaw, Texas, $2.890 million certificates of obligation and $2.190 million waterworks and sewer system revs.
--West Feliciana SD, La., $10 million GO school bonds.
--Williamsburg Community School District, Iowa, $2.3 million school building GOs.
